title: Fee Schedule Note: Amount of the Kestrel Rx Savings Club Renewal Fee (Savings & Copay Assistance Programs)
content:
The renewal fee of a Kestrel Rx Savings Club membership of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs is the program's enrollment fee, charged in full for the term.

The renewal fee is never below zero and is stated to the cent, rounded half up.

The enrollment fee is the program's figure on the membership fee and term schedule.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

| Membership | Enrollment fee | Renewal fee |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Rx Savings Club Individual | $20.00 | $20.00 |
| Kestrel Rx Savings Club Family | $35.00 | $35.00 |
